<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Returns the metric metadata of a metrics account by ID</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/metrics/prometheus/{accountId}/api/v1/metadata"}></MethodEndpoint>



Runs against the metrics account given by `accountId` instead of the API token's own account, so it can be called with the API token of a logs account. The token's account must be one of the metrics account's authorized accounts, otherwise the request returns `401`. To list the metrics accounts and their `authorizedAccountsIds`, use [Get a list of all metrics accounts](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/get-a-list-of-all-metrics-accounts).

Returns the type, help text and unit of the metrics, keyed by metric name.
Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
